nodes.title: 自动生成视频提示词｜图片分析
widgets_values:
你是AI视频提示词大师，根据用户上传的图片，生成提示词模板，不要废话，不要描写抽象概念，仅需简单描写主体，背景，主体动作, 整体视觉与情感美学,镜头类型、构图或运动, 场景设置与背景细节，提示词200字内，核心部分是主体的动作，不要分段生成，5秒内的视频动态

举例：

穿着女仆装的黑发美少女，在学校的运动场，手拿着篮球，花式运球，然后做出上篮动作，球进到篮筐，电影级质感，镜头开始聚焦女孩的脸部，逐渐拉远到全身视角，最后定格篮球进球的瞬间。

nodes.title: 图生视频提示词角色
widgets_values: 你是专业图生视频导演提示词专家。根据输入图片生成一段高质量 10 秒视频提示词，只输出一段成片可用的提示词。必须保持人物身份、五官、服装、发型、场景、光线和构图稳定；动作要有开始、发展、高潮和收束，节奏自然，适合后续对口型处理。避免遮挡嘴部、换脸、换衣、场景跳变、快速旋转、夸张推拉、肢体畸形、手指错误、文字水印。

nodes.title: 图生视频提示词要求
widgets_values: 基于图片写 10 秒图生视频提示词：人物面向镜头，自然说话或轻微表演，嘴部和脸部保持清晰可见，可以有轻微点头、眨眼、手势和上半身动作，但不要挡住嘴。镜头稳定，光线、背景和主体一致，动作连贯有观赏性，结尾自然停住。

nodes.title: Hunyuan Foley - generated video
widgets_values: footstep sound, clothing rustle, natural room tone

nodes.title: Lipsync sampler - low denoise preserve video

widgets_values: 10-second photorealistic portrait image-to-video, fixed vertical medium close-up, preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, glasses, clothing, lighting, and composition of the reference image: a middle-aged male doctor with thin metal-frame glasses, neatly side-parted black-and-gray short hair, wearing a white doctor’s coat over a gray shirt, seated behind a clinic desk and facing the camera directly. Keep the consultation room unchanged, including the windows, green plant, wall clock, and calm soft cool overhead indoor lighting; stable framing with no drift. From 0-2 seconds, he looks naturally into the camera, with subtle breathing and a slow blink, and his mouth begins speaking clearly. From 2-6 seconds, he enters a natural, continuous talking-head delivery with accurate, clear lip movement, slight nods, delicate facial expression changes, and very small realistic weight shifts in the shoulders, neck, and upper body. From 6-8 seconds, add one restrained low hand gesture, always kept below the chest and never blocking the mouth, with a slightly more emphatic expression and tone to create a mild peak. From 8-10 seconds, he finishes speaking and settles naturally, with a slight tightening at the corners of the mouth, a gentle nod, and then holds still. Overall motion must be realistic, restrained, smooth, and ideal for later lip-sync processing. Strictly avoid face changes, wardrobe changes, scene transitions, camera rotation, dramatic zooms, body distortion, bad fingers, mouth occlusion, blur, loss of focus, text, or watermark.

nodes.title: 拆分中间视频｜供音效和对口型使用

widgets_values: 你是专业音效提示词专家，根据传入的视频，用英文写100字内的音效提示词，不要出现废话，简单扼要

nodes.title: Foley prompt from generated video
widgets_values: Analyze the generated video and write one concise English Foley prompt within 100 words. Only output the sound prompt.
Quiet clinic room tone, soft air conditioner hum, faint wall clock ticking, subtle lab coat fabric rustle, light chair creaks, gentle breathing, minimal desk movement, clean close indoor ambience.

对口型正向提示词
widgets_values: natural speech lip sync, stable facial identity, clear mouth articulation, subtle head movement, consistent lighting, no scene change
